apps.name: ProtocolsTracker
apps.tagline: Track your daily compounds and actions
apps.description: Schedule recurring compounds (supplements and peptides) and actions with local reminders, check them off each day, and see how often you complete each one. Styled after the Solo Leveling System. Works fully offline.

apps.name: FinancialTracker
apps.tagline: Budget, paycheck split, debts and accounts, fed to LevelUp
apps.description: Owns Financial Well-Being for LevelUp. Import your budget workbook, enter a paycheck and see exactly where it goes (bills per card, debt payments, savings, and what is left for you). Track monthly expenses and debts, log Emergency Fund, 401k and Roth IRA contributions, and pay off debts one by one for XP. Links SoFi and Fidelity through Plaid for live balances. Encrypted cloud backup. Styled after the Solo Leveling System.

apps.name: HabitTracker
apps.tagline: Daily habits, weekly tasks and vices, fed to LevelUp
apps.description: Owns three areas for LevelUp: daily habits, weekly tasks and vices. Plan habits day by day (each week pre-fills from the last), keep a weekly to-do list, and log vices: clean weed days, No Porn, No Food Delivery and 3+ Drinks. Every check-off lands in LevelUp with its XP automatically. Styled after the Solo Leveling System. Works fully offline.

apps.name: TrainingTracker
apps.tagline: Plan and time training sessions, and feed them to LevelUp
apps.description: Owns Strength & Combat Skills for LevelUp: BJJ, Muay Thai, Boxing, MMA, Strength and Conditioning, and Workouts. Schedule sessions on a day or week grid, run a timer, and set weekly targets like 3 BJJ and 2 Muay Thai. Every completed session checks the matching activity off in LevelUp automatically. Cloud backup. Styled after the Solo Leveling System.

apps.name: LevelUp
apps.tagline: Level up your life across nine categories
apps.description: A gamified personal-development tracker. Earn XP and level up across nine life categories, read a plain-English consult on your last seven days, and collect completions from HabitTracker, TrainingTracker, WeeklyPlanner and ProtocolsTracker. Works fully offline.

apps.name: StudyTracker
apps.tagline: Plan study, music and career sessions, and feed them to LevelUp
apps.description: Plans and times the four areas it owns for LevelUp: Tech Skills, Musicianship, Career, and Study Math. Schedule sessions on a day or week grid, run a timer, set weekly targets for every area like 3 LinkedIn posts, and break study subjects into modules and lessons. Every completed session checks the matching activity off in LevelUp automatically. Styled after the Solo Leveling System. Works fully offline.
